entries.title: I Corinthians 9:1
segments: Am I not an apostle? Am I not free? Have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? Are you not my work in [the] Lord?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:2
segments: If I am not an apostle to others, yet doubtless I am to you, for you are the seal of my apostleship in [the] Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:3
segments: My answer to those who examine me is this:

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:4
segments: Do we not have authority to eat and to drink?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:5
segments: Do we not have authority to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and [as] the brothers of the Lord do, and Cephas?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:6
segments: Or [is it] only Barnabas and I [who] have no authority to cease working?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:7
segments: Who serves as a soldier at his own wages at any time? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock and does not partake of the milk of the flock?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:8
segments: Do I say these things according to man? Or does not the Law say the same also?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:9
segments: For it is written in the law of Moses, "You shall not muzzle the mouth of the ox treading out grain." Does God take care for oxen?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:10
segments: Or does He say [it] altogether for our sakes? It was written for us, so that he who plows should plow [in] hope, and so that he who threshes [in] hope should be partaker of his hope.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:11
segments: If we have sown to you spiritual things, [is it] a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:12
segments: If others have a share of [this] authority [over] you, rather [should] not we? But we have not used this authority, but we endured all things lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:13
segments: Do you not know that those who minister about holy things live [of the things] of the temple? And those attending the altar are partakers with the altar.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:14
segments: Even so, the Lord ordained those announcing the gospel to live from the gospel.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:15
segments: But I have used none of these things, nor have I written these things that it should be done so to me; for [it is] good for me rather to die than that anyone nullify my glorying.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:16
segments: For though I preach the gospel, no glory is to me. For necessity is laid on me; yea, woe is to me if I do not preach the gospel!

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:17
segments: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward; but if against my will, I am entrusted with a stewardship.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:18
segments: What then is my reward? That when I preach the gospel I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I may not abuse my authority in the gospel.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:19
segments: For though I am free from all, yet I have made myself servant to all, so that I might gain the more.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:20
segments: And to the Jews I became as a Jew, so that I might gain the Jews. To those who are under the Law, [I became] as under the Law, so that I might gain those who are under the Law.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:21
segments: To those who are outside Law, [I became] as outside Law (not being outside law to God, but under [the] law to Christ), so that I might gain those who are outside Law.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:22
segments: To the weak I became as the weak, so that I might gain the weak. I am made all things to all [men], so that I might by all means save some.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:23
segments: And this I do for the sake of the gospel, so that I might be partaker of it [with you].

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:24
segments: Do you not know that those running in a race all run, but one receives the prize? So run, that you may obtain.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:25
segments: And everyone who strives for the mastery is temperate in all things. Then those truly that they may receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:26
segments: So then I run, not as if I were uncertain. And so I fight, not as [one who] beats the air.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:27
segments: But I buffet my body, and lead [it] captive, lest proclaiming to others I myself might be rejected.
